title: Entity resolution merges two tenants' entities into one link count
summary: The nightly ontology reconciliation report shows one entity name with far more resolved links than the registry dashboard, and the registry team stopped trusting the run until it is explained.
task: Report how many distinct links resolved to each entity in the resolver's feed, so the registry team can confirm the overnight run did not drop or double-assign links.

company.notes: Foundry-shaped entity-resolution problem; an under-specified merge key that ignores the namespace, a subtle logic flaw with no syntax error.

expected_output:
=== Links resolved per entity ===
commercial/acme: 3
gov/acme: 2
commercial/globex: 4
commercial/initech: 2
gov/umbrella: 1
buggy_output:
=== Links resolved per entity ===
commercial/acme: 5
gov/acme: 5
commercial/globex: 4
commercial/initech: 2
gov/umbrella: 1

phase2.spec_patch: Ops onboarded a new tenant namespace, `research`, and its links must be folded into the same per-entity report. A `research` entity that shares a name with a `commercial` or `gov` entity is still a different entity. Namespaces stay distinct.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== Links resolved per entity ===
commercial/acme: 3
gov/acme: 2
research/acme: 1
commercial/globex: 4
research/globex: 2
commercial/initech: 2
gov/umbrella: 1
